title: termal_list_sessions returns 409 'federation authority changed' with no data, while the CLI lists at the same moment
outcome: During a federation-authority change, an MCP session listing either refreshes and succeeds or returns local sessions with a clear partial marker, so a session can still find an address, and the message names the supported next step.
acceptance: The cause of the 04:27Z refusal is identified from host and federation records, including why the CLI listing succeeded at the same time, and classified
A regression test covers the MCP listing across an authority change; the listing recovers without a host restart or a manual refresh the caller can't perform, and authority checks are not weakened
